notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.5
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
-Fixed a bug where Sensitivity would be set to 0 in some cases when applying settings, making the crosshair immovable
-Fixed a bug where the "Well That's Awkward..." Achievement would not unlock when it should
-Fixed a bug where the "Employee of the Month" Achievement would not unlock when it should
-Fixed a bug where Mouse Input would not behave as expected. The game should feel much smoother to play when using Mouse & Keyboard

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
We're aware of the following bugs at the moment that we hope to address sometime in the near future:

-Bats can get rarely stuck on themselves when navigating on the screen, causing them to stay on screen indefinitely. This can impact players trying to unlock the "Proud of You" Achievement. (If this happens, simply quit to the title screen and start another game)
-Music when starting a game is quiet, regardless of volume settings
